read.en: Coherent fell 6.0% on Nov 13 to $218.15, trading $207.69–233.58. It is above the 10-day ($209.0) and below the rising 5-day ($224.9), the 30-day ($243.3), 100-day ($287.5) and rising 200-day ($296.8). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram edging lower; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($169.46), and RSI is 45.7.
read.zh: Coherent 11月13日下跌 6.0%，收于 $218.15，盘中区间 $207.69–233.58。股价位于 10 日均线（$209.0）上方，位于上行的 5 日均线（$224.9）以及 30 日（$243.3）、100 日（$287.5）和上行的 200 日均线（$296.8）下方。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图小幅回落；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$169.46），RSI 为 45.7。

read.en: The drop broke the $220.7–229.5 support (Jul 29 low, Nov 9–11 band), now resistance, while the $207.69 low held the 10-day. Resistance is $220.7–225.2 (Jul 29 low, 5-day, Nov 9 close), then $232–234.5 (Nov 11–13 closes and high) and $241–245.7. Support is $207–209 (10-day, Nov 10 and 13 lows), then $192.8–195.1 and $169.5 (SAR). A close above $225.2 would target $232–234.5; below $207, $193–195.
